objects.name: active_embedding_spaces
objects.view_sql:
SELECT embedding_space_id,
    space_key,
    provider_type,
    provider_name,
    model_name,
    model_revision,
    vector_dimension,
    similarity_metric,
    preprocessing_version,
    lifecycle_status,
    created_at
   FROM knowledge.embedding_spaces
  WHERE is_active = true AND lifecycle_status = 'active'::text;

objects.name: production_chunk_embeddings
objects.view_sql:
SELECT e.chunk_embedding_id,
    e.chunk_id,
    e.embedding_space_id,
    s.space_key,
    s.provider_type,
    s.provider_name,
    s.model_name,
    s.model_revision,
    s.vector_dimension,
    s.similarity_metric,
    s.preprocessing_version,
    e.embedding,
    e.created_at,
    e.updated_at
   FROM knowledge.chunk_embeddings e
     JOIN knowledge.production_retrieval_chunks c ON c.chunk_id = e.chunk_id
     JOIN knowledge.active_embedding_spaces s ON s.embedding_space_id = e.embedding_space_id;

objects.name: production_culinary_knowledge
objects.view_sql:
WITH valid_sources AS (
         SELECT cis.item_id,
            cis.claim_key,
            cis.source_key,
            cis.source_name,
            cis.source_url,
            cis.source_license,
            cis.source_role,
            cis.evidence_note,
            cis.retrieved_at,
            cis.valid_from,
            cis.valid_until
           FROM knowledge.culinary_item_sources cis
             JOIN knowledge.knowledge_sources ks ON ks.source_id = cis.source_id
          WHERE cis.source_id IS NOT NULL AND cis.retrieved_at IS NOT NULL AND ks.verification_status = 'verified'::text AND ks.is_synthetic = false AND (cis.valid_from IS NULL OR cis.valid_from <= now()) AND (cis.valid_until IS NULL OR cis.valid_until >= now())
        ), localized_claims AS (
         SELECT i_1.item_id,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('claim_key', claim.value ->> 'claim_id'::text, 'locale', locale.key, 'text', locale.value) ORDER BY (claim.value ->> 'claim_id'::text), locale.key) AS claims
           FROM knowledge.culinary_knowledge_items i_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(i_1.claims) claim(value)
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(claim.value -> 'text_by_locale'::text) = 'object'::text THEN claim.value -> 'text_by_locale'::text
                    ELSE '{}'::jsonb
                END) locale(key, value)
          GROUP BY i_1.item_id
        ), claim_provenance AS (
         SELECT vs.item_id,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('claim_key', vs.claim_key, 'source_key', vs.source_key, 'source_name', vs.source_name, 'source_url', vs.source_url, 'license', vs.source_license, 'source_role', vs.source_role, 'evidence_note', vs.evidence_note, 'retrieved_at', vs.retrieved_at, 'valid_from', vs.valid_from, 'valid_until', vs.valid_until) ORDER BY vs.claim_key, vs.source_key) AS provenance
           FROM valid_sources vs
          GROUP BY vs.item_id
        )
 SELECT i.item_id,
    i.item_key,
    i.category,
    i.record_key,
    i.names_by_locale,
    i.descriptions_by_locale,
    lc.claims,
    cp.provenance,
    i.updated_at
   FROM knowledge.culinary_knowledge_items i
     JOIN localized_claims lc ON lc.item_id = i.item_id
     JOIN claim_provenance cp ON cp.item_id = i.item_id
  WHERE i.review_status = 'approved'::text AND i.publishable = true AND i.verification_status = 'verified'::text AND i.record_origin = 'verified_external'::text AND i.is_synthetic = false AND i.approval_confidence > 0::numeric AND i.published_at IS NOT NULL AND i.names_by_locale ?& ARRAY['fa-IR'::text, 'en-US'::text, 'ar'::text] AND i.descriptions_by_locale ?& ARRAY['fa-IR'::text, 'en-US'::text, 'ar'::text] AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(i.claims) claim(value)
          WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(claim.value ->> 'claim_id'::text), ''::text), ''::text) = ''::text OR jsonb_typeof(claim.value -> 'text_by_locale'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'::text OR NOT (claim.value -> 'text_by_locale'::text) ?& ARRAY['fa-IR'::text, 'en-US'::text, 'ar'::text] OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM unnest(ARRAY['fa-IR'::text, 'en-US'::text, 'ar'::text]) locale(code)
                  WHERE jsonb_typeof((claim.value -> 'text_by_locale'::text) -> locale.code) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'::text OR COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((claim.value -> 'text_by_locale'::text) ->> locale.code), ''::text), ''::text) = ''::text)) OR NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM valid_sources vs
                  WHERE vs.item_id = i.item_id AND vs.claim_key = (claim.value ->> 'claim_id'::text)))));

objects.name: production_destination_categories
objects.view_sql:
SELECT category_id,
    category_key,
    name_fa,
    description,
    sort_order
   FROM knowledge.destination_categories c
  WHERE is_active = true AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM knowledge.destination_category_map m
             JOIN knowledge.production_destinations d ON d.destination_id = m.destination_id
          WHERE m.category_id = c.category_id AND m.is_synthetic = false));

objects.name: production_destination_category_map
objects.view_sql:
SELECT m.destination_id,
    m.category_id,
    m.mapping_source,
    m.created_at
   FROM knowledge.destination_category_map m
     JOIN knowledge.production_destinations d ON d.destination_id = m.destination_id
     JOIN knowledge.production_destination_categories c ON c.category_id = m.category_id
  WHERE m.is_synthetic = false;

objects.name: production_destination_claim_evidence
objects.view_sql:
SELECT pd.destination_key AS canonical_entity_key,
    ce.destination_id,
    ce.document_id::text AS document_id,
    ce.chunk_id::text AS chunk_id,
    ce.claim_key,
    ce.content_hash::text AS content_hash,
    ce.locale,
    ce.corpus,
    ce.valid_from,
    ce.valid_until,
    ce.review_status = 'approved'::text AND ce.published_at IS NOT NULL AS is_published,
    pd.verification_status = 'verified'::text AND pd.is_synthetic = false AS is_destination_verified,
    rd.ingestion_status = 'processed'::text AND rd.record_origin = 'verified_external'::text AS is_document_processed,
    ce.is_synthetic OR rd.is_synthetic OR pd.is_synthetic AS is_synthetic,
    ce.verification_status = 'revoked'::text OR ce.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR ks.verification_status <> 'verified'::text OR ks.is_synthetic AS is_revoked,
    ce.source_id::text AS source_id,
    ce.source_name,
    ce.source_url,
    ce.source_role,
    ce.source_license AS license,
    ce.retrieved_at,
    ce.valid_from AS source_valid_from,
    ce.valid_until AS source_valid_until,
    ks.verification_status = 'verified'::text AS is_source_verified,
    ks.is_synthetic AS is_source_synthetic,
    ks.verification_status <> 'verified'::text AS is_source_revoked
   FROM knowledge.destination_claim_evidence ce
     JOIN knowledge.production_destinations pd ON pd.destination_id = ce.destination_id
     JOIN knowledge.production_retrieval_documents rd ON rd.document_id = ce.document_id AND rd.destination_id = ce.destination_id
     JOIN knowledge.production_retrieval_chunks rc ON rc.chunk_id = ce.chunk_id AND rc.document_id = ce.document_id AND rc.destination_id = ce.destination_id
     JOIN knowledge.production_destination_sources pds ON pds.destination_id = ce.destination_id AND pds.source_id = ce.source_id
     JOIN knowledge.knowledge_sources ks ON ks.source_id = ce.source_id
  WHERE ce.review_status = 'approved'::text AND ce.verification_status = 'verified'::text AND ce.is_synthetic = false AND ce.revoked_at IS NULL AND ce.content_hash = rc.content_sha256 AND ce.content_hash::text = encode(sha256(convert_to(rc.content, 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text) AND ce.source_name = pds.source_name AND ce.source_url = pds.source_url AND ce.source_role = pds.source_role AND NOT ce.retrieved_at IS DISTINCT FROM pds.retrieved_at AND NOT ce.valid_from IS DISTINCT FROM pds.valid_from AND NOT ce.valid_until IS DISTINCT FROM pds.valid_until AND
        CASE ce.locale
            WHEN 'fa-IR'::text THEN rd.language_code = ANY (ARRAY['fa'::text, 'fa-IR'::text])
            WHEN 'en-US'::text THEN rd.language_code = ANY (ARRAY['en'::text, 'en-US'::text])
            WHEN 'ar'::text THEN rd.language_code = 'ar'::text
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AND (ce.valid_from IS NULL OR ce.valid_from <= now()) AND (ce.valid_until IS NULL OR ce.valid_until >= now());

objects.name: production_destination_sources
objects.view_sql:
SELECT ds.destination_id,
    ds.source_id,
    ds.source_role,
    ds.evidence_note,
    ds.retrieved_at,
    ds.valid_from,
    ds.valid_until,
    s.source_name,
    s.source_type,
    s.url AS source_url,
    s.reliability_score
   FROM knowledge.destination_sources ds
     JOIN knowledge.production_destinations d ON d.destination_id = ds.destination_id
     JOIN knowledge.knowledge_sources s ON s.source_id = ds.source_id
  WHERE s.verification_status = 'verified'::text AND s.is_synthetic = false AND (ds.valid_from IS NULL OR ds.valid_from <= now()) AND (ds.valid_until IS NULL OR ds.valid_until >= now());

objects.name: production_destination_tags
objects.view_sql:
SELECT t.destination_id,
    t.tag
   FROM knowledge.destination_tags t
     JOIN knowledge.production_destinations d ON d.destination_id = t.destination_id;

objects.name: production_destinations
objects.view_sql:
SELECT destination_id,
    canonical_name,
    destination_type,
    province_name,
    city_name,
    description,
    difficulty,
    suitable_transport,
    local_language,
    local_food,
    local_souvenirs,
    best_travel_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    status,
    data_confidence,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    destination_key,
    country_code,
    aliases,
    parent_destination_id,
    record_origin,
    verification_status,
    is_synthetic,
    coordinate_role,
    location
   FROM knowledge.destinations d
  WHERE status = 'active'::text AND verification_status = 'verified'::text AND location IS NOT NULL AND coordinate_role <> 'unknown'::text AND record_origin = 'verified_external'::text AND is_synthetic = false AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM knowledge.destination_sources ds
             JOIN knowledge.knowledge_sources s ON s.source_id = ds.source_id
          WHERE ds.destination_id = d.destination_id AND s.verification_status = 'verified'::text AND s.is_synthetic = false AND (ds.valid_from IS NULL OR ds.valid_from <= now()) AND (ds.valid_until IS NULL OR ds.valid_until >= now())));

objects.name: production_retrieval_chunks
objects.view_sql:
SELECT c.chunk_id,
    c.document_id,
    d.destination_id,
    d.document_key,
    d.title,
    d.language_code,
    d.document_type,
    d.canonical_url,
    d.provenance_source_name,
    d.provenance_source_type,
    d.provenance_source_url,
    d.provenance_reliability_score,
    c.chunk_index,
    c.content,
    c.char_count,
    c.token_count,
    c.content_sha256,
    c.metadata,
    c.created_at
   FROM knowledge.knowledge_chunks c
     JOIN knowledge.production_retrieval_documents d ON d.document_id = c.document_id
  WHERE c.is_synthetic = false;

objects.name: production_retrieval_documents
objects.view_sql:
SELECT d.document_id,
    d.document_key,
    d.source_id,
    d.destination_id,
    d.title,
    d.language_code,
    d.document_type,
    d.canonical_url,
    d.raw_content,
    d.content_sha256,
    d.ingestion_status,
    d.record_origin,
    d.is_synthetic,
    d.retrieved_at,
    d.valid_from,
    d.valid_until,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at,
    s.source_name AS provenance_source_name,
    s.source_type AS provenance_source_type,
    s.url AS provenance_source_url,
    s.reliability_score AS provenance_reliability_score
   FROM knowledge.knowledge_documents d
     JOIN knowledge.knowledge_sources s ON s.source_id = d.source_id
  WHERE d.ingestion_status = 'processed'::text AND d.record_origin = 'verified_external'::text AND d.is_synthetic = false AND s.verification_status = 'verified'::text AND s.is_synthetic = false AND (d.valid_from IS NULL OR d.valid_from <= now()) AND (d.valid_until IS NULL OR d.valid_until >= now()) AND (d.destination_id IS NULL OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM knowledge.production_destinations pd
          WHERE pd.destination_id = d.destination_id)));

objects.name: share_eligible_organizations

objects.name: geography_columns
objects.view_sql:
SELECT current_database() AS f_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS f_table_schema,
    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geography_column,
    postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod) AS coord_dimension,
    postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod) AS srid,
    postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod) AS type
   FROM pg_class c,
    pg_attribute a,
    pg_type t,
    pg_namespace n
  WHERE t.typname = 'geography'::name AND a.attisdropped = false AND a.atttypid = t.oid AND a.attrelid = c.oid AND c.relnamespace = n.oid AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);

objects.name: geometry_columns
objects.view_sql:
SELECT current_database()::character varying(256) AS f_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS f_table_schema,
    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geometry_column,
    COALESCE(postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod), sn.ndims, 2) AS coord_dimension,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod), 0), sr.srid, 0) AS srid,
    replace(replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod)), 'GEOMETRY'::text), st.type, 'GEOMETRY'::text), 'ZM'::text, ''::text), 'Z'::text, ''::text)::character varying(30) AS type
   FROM pg_class c
     JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND NOT a.attisdropped
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid
     JOIN pg_type t ON a.atttypid = t.oid
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (regexp_match(s.consrc, 'geometrytype\(\w+\)\s*=\s*''(\w+)'''::text, 'i'::text))[1] AS type
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~* 'geometrytype\(\w+\)\s*=\s*''\w+'''::text) st ON st.connamespace = n.oid AND st.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (st.conkey))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (regexp_match(s.consrc, 'ndims\(\w+\)\s*=\s*(\d+)'::text, 'i'::text))[1]::integer AS ndims
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~* 'ndims\(\w+\)\s*=\s*\d+'::text) sn ON sn.connamespace = n.oid AND sn.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sn.conkey))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (regexp_match(s.consrc, 'srid\(\w+\)\s*=\s*(\d+)'::text, 'i'::text))[1]::integer AS srid
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~* 'srid\(\w+\)\s*=\s*\d+'::text) sr ON sr.connamespace = n.oid AND sr.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sr.conkey))
  WHERE (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT c.relname = 'raster_columns'::name AND t.typname = 'geometry'::name AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);
